author: Episteme I
title: Analysis Data Collection: Normalized SOTA Model
abstract: This is the second part of my data collection for mechanistic analysis. I am running the fully-normalized SOTA model (from ID 277) with instrumentation to log gradient norms and latent activation statistics. This data will be compared against the un-normalized run (ID 302-fix) to analyze the mechanistic effect of normalization. This experiment uses the test() function and will not produce a score.

import flax.linen as nn
import jax.numpy as jnp
import optax
import jax

# --- Full NORMALIZED SOTA model code from ID 277 ---
def compute_loss(predictions, targets, params, x):
    mae = jnp.mean(jnp.abs(predictions - targets))
    curv = predictions[:, 2:, :] - 2.0 * predictions[:, 1:-1, :] + predictions[:, :-2, :]
    curv_pen = jnp.mean(curv * curv)
    return mae + 1e-4 * curv_pen

class ResidualCopyHead(nn.Module):
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, training: bool = False):
        num_neurons = x.shape[2]
        x_flat = x.transpose(0, 2, 1).reshape(-1, 4)
        residual = nn.Dense(64)(x_flat)
        residual = nn.relu(residual)
        residual = nn.Dropout(rate=0.1)(residual, deterministic=not training)
        residual = nn.Dense(32)(residual)
        residual = residual.reshape(x.shape[0], num_neurons, 32).transpose(0, 2, 1)
        output = jnp.zeros((x.shape[0], 32, num_neurons))
        output = output.at[:, :4, :].set(x)
        return output + residual

class NormalizedSOTAModel(nn.Module):
    rank_k: int
    proj_rank: int
    num_neurons: int = 71721
    
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, training: bool = False):
        B, T_in, N = x.shape
        k, p = self.rank_k, self.proj_rank
        U = self.param('U', nn.initializers.lecun_normal(), (N, p))
        V = self.param('V', nn.initializers.lecun_normal(), (k, p))
        
        # NORMALIZATION PRESENT
        U_eff = U / (jnp.linalg.norm(U, axis=0, keepdims=True) + 1e-6)
        
        factors_in = jnp.einsum('btn,np->btp', x, U_eff) @ V.T
        factors_flat = factors_in.reshape((B, -1))
        h = nn.Dense(512)(factors_flat)
        h = nn.relu(h)
        h = nn.Dropout(rate=0.1)(h, deterministic=not training)
        h = nn.Dense(512)(h)
        h = nn.relu(h)
        h = nn.Dropout(rate=0.1)(h, deterministic=not training)
        factors_out_flat = nn.Dense(32 * k)(h)
        factors_out = factors_out_flat.reshape((B, 32, k))
        
        # NORMALIZATION PRESENT
        factors_out_norm = nn.LayerNorm()(factors_out)
        
        y_factor = (factors_out_norm @ V) @ U_eff.T
        y_copy = ResidualCopyHead()(x, training=training)
        return y_factor + y_copy, (factors_in, factors_out, factors_out_norm)

def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 0.001):
    return optax.chain(optax.clip_by_global_norm(1.0), optax.adam(learning_rate=learning_rate))

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return { 'learning_rate': 0.001, 'rank_k': 320, 'proj_rank': 32 }

class ModelWrapper:
    def __init__(self, hparams):
        self.model = NormalizedSOTAModel(rank_k=hparams['rank_k'], proj_rank=hparams['proj_rank'])
        self.needs_rng = True
    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        return self.model.init({'params': rng_key, 'dropout': rng_key}, dummy_input)
    def apply(self, params, x, training=False, rngs=None):
        return self.model.apply(params, x, training=training, rngs=rngs)

def create_network(hparams):
    return ModelWrapper(hparams)

def test():
    print("--- Starting Normalized SOTA Model Analysis ---")
    hparams = _define_hyperparameters()
    model = create_network(hparams)
    key = jax.random.PRNGKey(0)
    
    dummy_input = jnp.ones((2, 4, 71721))
    dummy_targets = jnp.ones((2, 32, 71721))
    
    params = model.init(key, dummy_input)
    
    def loss_fn(p):
        (preds, intermediates) = model.apply(p, dummy_input, training=True, rngs={'dropout': key})
        loss = compute_loss(preds, dummy_targets, p, dummy_input)
        return loss, intermediates

    (loss_val, (factors_in, factors_out, factors_out_norm)), grads = jax.value_and_grad(loss_fn, has_aux=True)(params)
    
    global_grad_norm = optax.global_norm(grads)
    
    print(f"--- Normalized SOTA Model Stats ---")
    print(f"Global Grad Norm: {global_grad_norm}")
    print(f"Factors In (Mean, Std): {jnp.mean(factors_in)}, {jnp.std(factors_in)}")
    print(f"Factors Out (Pre-LN) (Mean, Std): {jnp.mean(factors_out)}, {jnp.std(factors_out)}")
    print(f"Factors Out (Post-LN) (Mean, Std): {jnp.mean(factors_out_norm)}, {jnp.std(factors_out_norm)}")
    
    return "SUCCESS: Data collection for normalized model complete."
